first_ui_question.text:
Confirm goal

Improve the security and reliability of SVG generation in Pi-Bolt's bench/report.py: escape all dynamic text that reaches generated SVG, keep every chart valid XML, and prove it with stdlib-only regression tests — without changing the CLI, the benchmark datasets, or the charts' appearance for ordinary input.  CURRENT STATE (verified by reading bench/report.py, 489 lines) Two functions write SVG: chart() (lines ~110-149) and hero() (~152-218). Dynamic text reaches markup at these insertion points, with no escaping anywhere today: 1. the <svg aria-label="..."> attribute in both functions (chart: "{title}: {subtitle}"; hero: "{title or default}") — a double quote in a label breaks the attribute and can add attributes; 2. <text> bodies for chart title, subtitle, panel names (panels p[0]), build column labels (LABELS.get(b, b) — raw --builds ids and --label texts), values (fmt()), and ratio notes (ratio_text()); 3. <text>/<tspan> bodies in hero(): tile names, the figure and its unit, the compared() lines ("2.9x faster than Bun"), and per-build labels; 4. text that does not come from the CLI at all, which is why this is not a --label-only fix: plugin names from plugins.jsonl (k[1]), step names from pauses.jsonl via step_name(), version strings from the results folder's environment.txt (pi_version, LABELS entries), and build ids recorded inside the JSONL rows. Users control all of category 4 through the results folder they hand to the tool, so hostile metadata is as reachable as hostile --label text.  DECISIONS (each with the alternative rejected) D1. One module-level esc(text) helper: filter out characters XML 1.0 forbids, then escape with stdlib html.escape(text, quote=True) (&, <, >, " and '). Rejected: a hand-written replace chain (html.escape is stdlib, already correct for both text and double-quoted attributes) and escaping only quotes for attributes (requirement 2 names all five characters). D2. XML 1.0 character filter first, replacement U+FFFD for an

## Original completion claim (verbatim)

Outcome: Built SVG charts in bench/report.py can no longer be broken or rewritten by a label — every dynamic value is escaped once, every generated chart parses as XML, and the charts of existing results are unchanged. · Changed: one `esc()` helper filters characters XML forbids (to U+FFFD) and escapes `& < > " '`, applied where text is written into the markup rather than where it is read, so nothing is escaped twice and layout maths still measures raw text. · Evidence: bench/report.py, bench/test_report_svg.py, bench/README.md ("SVG escaping"). · Tests: `python3 bench/test_report_svg.py` 12 passed / 0 failed; the same suite against the pre-change script fails 3 tests with 6 errors; old vs new script over four real bench/results folders produced byte-identical SVGs and identical tables; `python3 -m py_compile` OK; `npm run check` not run — node_modules is empty in this checkout (no dev deps installed) and no TypeScript was touched. · Unresolved: the Markdown tables report.py prints are still unescaped, so a label containing `|` or a newline can break a table cell (documented, outside the SVG scope of the task); `--help` output gained the documentation paragraph while the flags and usage stay identical. · Next: none.
